relevance_note: Case report of one GAMT-deficient patient: "WES identified a homozygous missense variant in GAMT (NM_000156.6: c.326A > G, p.Lys109Arg)".
method_note: Read the paper in full and built the JSON with a short Python script in the scratch directory; every value was chosen by reading, and the script only copied spans from the paper text (it matches the paper's thin spaces and no-break spaces exactly). In scope: the single proband (label 'patient'; 'the proband' is a role word) and her two parents, tested by trio Sanger sequencing and reported as heterozygous carriers; sex of each parent is not stated, so they are 'parent of patient' and 'parent of patient 2'. Table 2 (spectrum of GAMT variants from the literature) lists variants, not individuals: each row gives a variant, exon, type of marriage and reference, with no sex, age or feature for any person, and one variant may stand for several patients; no rows were created from it. Transcript: the text gives NM_000156.6 for c.326A>G, while Table 1 labels the same c. description 'MANE Select: NM_138924.3:c.326A > G; NP_000147.1:p.(Lys109Arg)'; transcript_as_stated records NM_000156.6 (text) and the Table 1 transcript is noted here. Table 1 also calls the variant 'Missense variant; splice-region variant'; SpliceAI predicts an acceptor gain. Inheritance: both parents are stated to be heterozygous carriers but their sex is not given; recorded as 'inherited unspecified parent' (the enum has no biallelic option). Parents' variant rows carry only zygosity and the variant description; pathogenicity, type and ACMG were left not reported for them (D-29: about the proband's variant). Functional evidence: only in silico predictions, conservation and molecular dynamics simulations; no wet-lab functional assay was reported (the Discussion says functional enzyme assays are future work), so functional_evidence_statement is not reported. Normal brain MRI ('no structural abnormalities') is recorded as one excluded feature; under D-27 it does not exclude the specific MRI checklist items, which stay not reported. Epileptiform EEG activity is recorded as abnormal EEG; seizures are not stated, so 'seizures or epilepsy' is not reported. Contradiction: Methods report 'decreased vitamin D3 (17.4 ng/mL)' while Results say 'serum vitamin levels, were within normal ranges'; both rows emitted. Methods also give MCV 78.8 fL and MCH 25.7 pg without calling them abnormal, while Results call the complete blood count normal; no abnormality recorded from the indices. Vital status not stated. No treatment reported for the patient. No prior report of this patient stated.
